faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Can't find your answer? Check the
faq.catClientsQ1: How do I find a provider?
faq.catClientsA1: Search a sector from the homepage or the "Find a provider" menu, or type directly what you're looking for in the search bar. Then compare verified profiles, reviews and indicative prices near you.
faq.catClientsQ2: How do I contact a provider?
faq.catClientsA2: From their profile or a result card, click "Contact": a conversation opens directly with them in your messages.
faq.catClientsA3: Yes. Every client account has a monthly quota of free contacts, visible on your dashboard. The counter resets automatically the following month.
faq.catClientsQ4: How do I post a precise request instead of searching myself?
faq.catClientsA4: From "Post a request", describe your need (title, skills needed, budget, urgency, location): WorkTogo then suggests the best-suited profiles, ranked by relevance.
faq.catClientsA5: The star button on a provider profile adds them to your favorites, accessible from "My space". Handy to reach out again later to a provider you've spotted.
faq.catClientsA6: Once the collaboration is complete, client and provider can rate each other (1 to 5 stars, with an optional comment) from the message thread. Each party can only rate the same collaboration once.
faq.catProvidersQ1: How do I become a provider on WorkTogo?
faq.catProvidersA1: Click "Become a provider", create your account (number verified by code), choose your sector of activity, then your subscription plan and payment method.
faq.catProvidersQ2: How many requests can I receive per month?
faq.catProvidersA2: It depends on your plan: 5 requests per month on Monthly, 20 on Quarterly, and unlimited on Annual. Full details are on the Pricing page.
faq.catProvidersQ3: How do I get the "Verified" badge?
faq.catProvidersA3: By verifying your identity (ID card + passport photo) from "Edit my profile". It's independent of your subscription plan, but required to be contacted by a client.
faq.catProvidersQ4: How does my subscription payment work?
faq.catProvidersA4: Payment is made via Mobile Money (Flooz or T-Money). A free 14-day trial is offered on first subscription, with no commitment beyond the first period.
faq.catProvidersQ5: Can I change plans along the way?
faq.catProvidersA5: Yes, you can upgrade to a higher plan from the Pricing page at any time.
faq.catAccountQ1: How do I edit my profile (name, location…)?
faq.catAccountA1: From the account menu (top right), click "Edit my profile".
faq.catAccountQ2: How do I change my password?
faq.catAccountA2: From the account menu, click "Change password". Your current password will be requested for security.
faq.catAccountQ3: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.catAccountA3: Automatic password reset is coming soon. In the meantime, contact support: we'll help you regain access to your account.
faq.catAccountQ4: Can I have both a client account and a provider account?
faq.catAccountA4: An account is tied to a single, permanent role. From the account menu, "Switch account" directs you either to log in to an existing account with the other role (if you already have one, with a different number or email), or to create a new account.
faq.catAccountQ5: Why do I need to verify my identity?
faq.catAccountA5: Verification (ID card + white-background passport photo) is optional at sign-up, but required afterwards: for a client, before posting their first request; for a provider, before being contacted by a client. It certifies your account ("Verified" badge) and strengthens trust between users. Complete it at any time from "Edit my profile".
faq.catAccountQ6: How do I delete my account?
faq.catAccountA6: Self-service deletion isn't available yet. Contact support with your request: we'll proceed with deleting your account and your data, subject to legally required retention periods.
faq.catPrivacyQ1: Is my data shared with third parties?
faq.catPrivacyA1: No. Your contact details are only shared with the person you contact yourself via messaging. Full details are in the Privacy Policy.
faq.catPrivacyA2: The "Verified" badge relies on the ID card and passport photo uploaded by the user, client or provider. It confirms the consistency of the declared information, without replacing your own vigilance: compare reviews, talk before committing, and report any suspicious behavior.
faq.catPrivacyQ3: How do I report an issue with a client or a provider?
faq.catPrivacyA3: Use the "File a complaint" page, accessible from the help center. Describe the situation: our team will get back to you.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie management
cookiesPage.intro: This page explains what a cookie is, which cookies WorkTogo uses, and how you can manage them.
cookiesPage.s1Body1: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website, which allows your browser to be recognised on subsequent visits or lets certain information be kept from one page to another.
cookiesPage.s2Body1: WorkTogo only uses cookies strictly necessary for the service to function:
cookiesPage.s2List1: Session cookie (wt_session): keeps you logged in to your account while you browse. It is deleted when you log out or when the session expires.
cookiesPage.s2List2: Interface preference cookie: remembers certain display choices (for example a filter or sort preference) to improve your experience.
cookiesPage.s3Body1: WorkTogo currently uses no advertising cookies or third-party audience-measurement cookies (such as Google Analytics or equivalent). Should this change, this page will be updated and your consent collected where required.
cookiesPage.s3Body2: Geolocation (searching for nearby providers) and the conversational assistant do not rely on any cookie: these are separate features, activated only by an explicit action on your part, described in our Privacy Policy.
cookiesPage.s4Body1: As the cookies used by WorkTogo are strictly necessary for the service to function (authentication, security), they are not subject to prior consent collection, in line with practices applicable to this type of cookie.
cookiesPage.s5Body1: You can configure your browser at any time to block or delete cookies. Blocking the session cookie will, however, prevent you from staying logged in to your WorkTogo account.
cookiesPage.s6Body1: For any question regarding the cookies used by WorkTogo: {email}.

confidentialitePage.title: Privacy Policy
confidentialitePage.intro: {company} places great importance on protecting your personal data. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and what your rights are.
confidentialitePage.s1Body1: The controller responsible for processing personal data collected on WorkTogo is {company}, reachable at {email}.
confidentialitePage.s2Body1: Depending on your use of the service, we may collect:
confidentialitePage.s2List1: Identification data: name, phone number, email address, password (stored encrypted);
confidentialitePage.s2List2: Profile data: sector of activity, description, service area, indicative rates, photo (for providers);
confidentialitePage.s2List3: Geolocation data: precise GPS position if you explicitly authorise it (dedicated button, never activated automatically), or manually entered neighbourhood/city — see the "Geolocation" section below;
confidentialitePage.s2List4: Identity verification data: photo of your ID card and passport photo, voluntarily uploaded to certify your account (client or provider) — never shown to other users;
confidentialitePage.s2List5: Usage data: messages exchanged via messaging, contact requests, reviews and ratings, favourites, questions asked to the conversational assistant (see "AI Assistant" below);
confidentialitePage.s2List6: Payment data: Mobile Money transaction references linked to a subscription (WorkTogo never stores any Mobile Money secret code or identifier);
confidentialitePage.s2List7: Technical data: cookies and session identifiers necessary for the service to function (see the Cookies page).
confidentialitePage.s3List1: Create and manage your account and authenticate you;
confidentialitePage.s3List2: Enable matchmaking between clients and providers;
confidentialitePage.s3List3: Certify account identity ("Verified" badge), required before a client's first request or a provider's first contact received;
confidentialitePage.s3List4: Display profiles, reviews and ratings on the platform;
confidentialitePage.s3List6: Provide support, handle your complaints, and respond to your requests;
confidentialitePage.s3List7: Improve the security and proper functioning of the service.
confidentialitePage.s4Body1: Personal data processing carried out on WorkTogo is subject to Togolese law n° 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on the protection of personal data, under the supervision of the Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP).
confidentialitePage.s4Body2: The processing described above is based on the performance of the contract binding you to WorkTogo (providing the service), on your consent where required (non-essential cookies), or on WorkTogo's legitimate interest in ensuring the security and improvement of the platform.
confidentialitePage.s5Body1: WorkTogo offers a proximity search for providers ("within X km"), centred on Lomé and the Maritime Region. Your precise location is never collected automatically: it is only transmitted if you explicitly click a "Use my current location" button, which triggers your browser's native permission request. You may refuse this permission at any time and search by neighbourhood or city instead — search remains fully usable without ever sharing your location.
confidentialitePage.s5Body2: By default, the position saved on a provider's listing is never shown publicly at exact precision: only their neighbourhood (or a position approximated to within a few hundred metres) is visible to other users, unless the provider explicitly chooses to display a precise position ("approximate position" disabled from their profile).
confidentialitePage.s5Body3: You can delete the precise position saved on your account at any time, without deleting your account itself, from the "Identity" section of your profile ("Delete my saved position" button).
confidentialitePage.s5Body4: When you use geolocation, an optional conversion of your coordinates into a neighbourhood name may be performed via OpenStreetMap/Nominatim (open mapping service): see the "Data sharing" section below.
confidentialitePage.s6Body1: WorkTogo offers a conversational assistant designed to answer your questions about the platform and recommend genuinely registered providers. It is an artificial intelligence, never a human — the assistant reminds you of this on request, and a link to human support always remains accessible in the widget.
confidentialitePage.s6Body2: The messages you send to the assistant, as well as your location if you provided it to the search, are transmitted to our artificial intelligence provider (Anthropic, a third-party company) to generate a response — see "Data sharing" below. The assistant never recommends a fictional provider: its responses rely solely on listings genuinely registered on WorkTogo.
confidentialitePage.s6Body3: A short conversation history is kept to give the assistant context from one message to the next (see "Retention period"). If the assistant is unavailable, the platform remains fully usable via standard search and the FAQ page.
confidentialitePage.s7Body1: Your profile data (name, sector, reviews, rating) is visible to other users as part of the normal matchmaking service. The ID card and passport photo uploaded for verification, however, are never shared with other users: only the outcome (verified account or not) is visible. WorkTogo does not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes.
confidentialitePage.s7Body2: Your data may be disclosed to technical providers strictly necessary for the service to function (hosting, sending verification codes, processing Mobile Money payments), who are bound by a confidentiality obligation, or to competent authorities where Togolese law requires it.
confidentialitePage.s7Body3: Two additional technical providers are involved for the geolocation and AI assistant features described above: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim (converting GPS coordinates into a neighbourhood name, called directly from your browser, with no WorkTogo account or identifier transmitted) and Anthropic (generating the conversational assistant's responses, based solely on the messages you send it).
confidentialitePage.s8Body1: Retention periods vary depending on the nature of the data:
confidentialitePage.s8List1: Account data (identity, profile, messages, reviews): for the entire lifetime of your account, then erased or anonymised within a reasonable period after it is closed;
confidentialitePage.s8List2: Verification ID documents (ID card, passport photo): the images themselves are automatically erased 90 days after submission — only your account's "Verified" status is kept, without the documents being retained indefinitely;
confidentialitePage.s8List3: Precise GPS position: kept until you delete it yourself (see "Geolocation" above) or delete your account — it does not expire automatically, as its usefulness (distance-based search) does not diminish over time as long as you haven't moved;
confidentialitePage.s8List4: Conversation history with the AI assistant: kept for the duration of the current chat session, to give the assistant context from one message to the next, then automatically erased beyond a limited number of recent exchanges;
confidentialitePage.s8List5: Payment and subscription data: retained beyond account closure where Togolese law requires it for accounting and tax purposes, even if your account is deleted or anonymised in the meantime;
confidentialitePage.s8List6: Cookies and technical data: see the retention periods indicated on our Cookie Management page.
confidentialitePage.s9Body1: WorkTogo implements reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss, unauthorised access or disclosure: encrypted passwords (never stored in plain text), sessions authenticated via secure cookie, access to identity verification documents strictly limited to their owner, and automatic erasure of these documents once the retention period above has elapsed.
confidentialitePage.s9Body2: A security audit of the storage of the most sensitive data (identity documents, location, payment history) has been carried out and leads to continuous improvements as the platform evolves.
confidentialitePage.s10Body1: In accordance with Togolese law n° 2019-014 on the protection of personal data, you have the following rights over your data:
confidentialitePage.s10List1: Right of access and portability: download a structured copy of your data at any time from your profile ("My data" section);
confidentialitePage.s10List2: Right of rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data from your profile;
confidentialitePage.s10List3: Right to erasure: delete your account directly from your profile ("My data" section) — your identifying data is then erased, subject to the legal retention obligations mentioned above;
confidentialitePage.s10List4: Right to object: object, on legitimate grounds, to processing of your data;
confidentialitePage.s11Body1: Downloading your data and deleting your account are available as self-service from your WorkTogo profile ("My data" section), without waiting for a manual response.
confidentialitePage.s11Body2: For any other request relating to your data (in-depth rectification request, right to object, question about this policy), contact us at {email} or {phone}. A response will be provided as soon as possible.
confidentialitePage.s11Body3: If, after contacting us, you believe your rights are not being respected, you may lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP), the competent supervisory authority in Togo.
confidentialitePage.s12Body1: WorkTogo uses cookies strictly necessary for the service to function. Details of these cookies and how to manage them are described on our Cookie Management page.
confidentialitePage.s13Body1: WorkTogo is not intended for minors. We do not knowingly collect data concerning minors.
confidentialitePage.s14Body1: This policy may be updated to reflect changes to the service or applicable regulations. The date of the last update appears at the top of this page.

cguPage.title: Terms of Service
cguPage.intro: These Terms of Service ("ToS") govern access to and use of the WorkTogo platform by any person — client or provider. By creating an account or using the service, you accept these ToS without reservation.
cguPage.s1Body1: WorkTogo is a digital platform that connects people looking for a service ("clients") with independent professionals offering their services ("providers"), across all sectors of activity, throughout Togo.
cguPage.s1Body2: These ToS apply to any use of the site, the application, and associated features (search, messaging, reviews, provider subscription), to the exclusion of any other terms not expressly accepted by WorkTogo.
cguPage.s2List1: "Client": a user creating an account to search for and contact a provider.
cguPage.s2List2: "Provider": an independent user creating an account to offer their services and receive requests.
cguPage.s2List3: "Content": any information, text, note or message published by a user on the platform.
cguPage.s2List4: "Matchmaking": the act, by WorkTogo, of enabling a client and a provider to communicate via the built-in messaging.
cguPage.s3Body1: Registration requires a valid phone number or email address, verified by a one-time code, as well as a password. The user chooses at registration whether they are acting as a client or a provider; this role is final for the account created.
cguPage.s3Body2: The user undertakes to provide accurate, up-to-date and complete information when registering and to keep it up to date, as well as to keep their password confidential. Any activity carried out from an account is presumed to have been carried out by its holder.
cguPage.s3Body3: Registration is reserved for persons of legal age or legally capable of contracting under Togolese law.
cguPage.s3Body4: Identity verification (ID card and passport photo) is optional at the time of registration, but becomes mandatory before a client posts their first request or a provider can be contacted by a client — see article 4 below.
cguPage.s4Body1: WorkTogo acts exclusively as a technical matchmaking intermediary. WorkTogo is not a party to any service contract entered into, where applicable, between a client and a provider, and does not intervene in its negotiation, performance, or payment.
cguPage.s4Body2: Profile verification ("Verified" badge) is based on the ID card and passport photo uploaded by the user, client or provider, and only confirms the consistency of the declared elements provided. It constitutes neither a guarantee of competence, nor a professional certification, nor a criminal background check.
cguPage.s5Heading: 5. Use of the service by clients
cguPage.s5Body1: Clients may search for providers by sector, compare profiles, reviews and indicative rates, and contact a number of providers free of charge each month, within the limit of the quota in effect displayed in the application.
cguPage.s5Body2: Clients undertake to use messaging in good faith, not to solicit providers for purposes unrelated to a genuine service need, and to fill in the first-contact form honestly when required.
cguPage.s6Heading: 6. Use of the service by providers
cguPage.s6Body1: Providers undertake to honestly describe their activity, skills, service area and indicative rates, and to carry out their activity in compliance with Togolese regulations applicable to their sector (authorisations, qualifications or insurance that may be required).
cguPage.s6Body2: Receiving contact requests beyond the free quota is subject to subscribing to a plan, described in the following article.
cguPage.s6Body3: The provider remains solely responsible for and free in the conduct of their activity: they set their own indicative rate, decide their own availability, and retain at all times the ability to decline or cancel a request before it begins, without penalty or justification other than the reason required by the cancellation procedure. WorkTogo imposes on them neither hours, nor exclusivity, nor a method for performing the service.
cguPage.s7Body1: Providers access the subscription plans described on the Pricing page. Each plan specifies its duration, price and included features (request quota, featured placement, "Verified" badge, priority support).
cguPage.s7Body2: Payment is made via Mobile Money (Flooz, T-Money). The subscription takes effect upon payment confirmation and is not automatically renewed without the user's action, unless otherwise stated at the time of subscription. Except where mandatory legal provisions state otherwise, amounts paid for a subscription period already begun are non-refundable.
cguPage.s8Heading: 8. Full payment for services via the platform
cguPage.s8Body1: The price of any service arranged via WorkTogo must be paid in full — with no deposit or remaining balance settled separately — using the platform's escrow payment system, before the service begins. No part of the agreed amount may be paid in cash or by any other means outside the platform between the client and the provider.
cguPage.s8Body2: This rule protects the client, whose funds remain held in escrow until the service is validated, and the provider, whose payment is guaranteed as soon as it is placed in escrow. It applies to the entire agreed amount, including in the event the scope of the service changes during the intervention.
cguPage.s9Heading: 9. Payment guarantee, insurance and featured placement
cguPage.s9Body1: The payment guarantee (client's funds secured in escrow until the service is validated), any civil liability insurance cover associated with a service, and featured placement at the top of search results linked to the subscription plan taken out, benefit only services fully recorded and paid for via the platform's payment system.
cguPage.s9Body2: None of these benefits can be activated or enforced against WorkTogo for a service agreed, performed or paid for in whole or in part outside the platform, even where the initial matchmaking took place via WorkTogo.
cguPage.s10Body1: At the end of a collaboration, clients and providers may rate each other and leave a comment. Reviews must reflect a genuine, lived experience; any false, defamatory review, or one published in exchange for a benefit, is prohibited and may be removed.
cguPage.s10Body2: WorkTogo reserves the right to moderate or remove a review that is manifestly contrary to these ToS, without any obligation of prior justification.
cguPage.s11Body1: It is prohibited for any user to:
cguPage.s11List1: Provide false identity, skill or pricing information;
cguPage.s11List2: Use the platform for unlawful, fraudulent purposes or unsolicited canvassing;
cguPage.s11List3: Circumvent messaging or quotas by creating multiple accounts;
cguPage.s11List4: Pay or agree to pay all or part of the price of a service in cash or by any other means outside the platform, in circumvention of article 8;
cguPage.s11List5: Publish content that is abusive, discriminatory, defamatory or infringes the rights of a third party;
cguPage.s11List6: Attempt to access, without authorisation, the systems, accounts or data of others.
cguPage.s12Body1: The platform's elements (brand, logo, interface, code) are protected by intellectual property law and may not be reproduced without authorisation. Each user remains the owner of the content they publish and guarantees they hold the rights necessary for its publication.
cguPage.s13Body1: The processing of users' personal data is described in the Privacy Policy, which forms an integral part of these ToS.
cguPage.s14Body1: WorkTogo strives to ensure the accuracy of the information displayed and the availability of the service, without any guarantee of result. WorkTogo cannot be held liable for the quality, compliance or proper performance of services agreed between a client and a provider, nor for damages resulting from their relationship.
cguPage.s14Body2: WorkTogo cannot guarantee that the service will operate free of any interruption, error or technical anomaly, and implements reasonable means to remedy this within a suitable timeframe.
cguPage.s15Body1: Any user may request the closure of their account at any time by contacting support. WorkTogo may suspend or terminate an account, with or without notice depending on the severity of the facts, in the event of a breach of these ToS, in particular the prohibited conduct listed in article 11.
cguPage.s15Body2: Except in cases of urgency or repeat offence, sanctions are graduated: warning, then temporary suspension, then permanent termination. Proven circumvention of the platform (article 11) — in particular arranging or accepting an off-platform settlement following matchmaking initiated on WorkTogo — may result in immediate suspension or termination, without notice or refund of amounts already committed (ongoing subscription, service fees), and without prejudice to any action for compensation for damage suffered by WorkTogo.
cguPage.s15Body3: Any user may report suspected circumvention from the application or to support. Each report, as well as attempts automatically detected by the platform, is verified by the support team before any sanction — no sanction is applied on the sole basis of an automatic detection not verified by a person.
cguPage.s16Body1: WorkTogo offers a search for providers by geographic proximity, centred on Lomé and the Maritime Region. This feature relies on a location the user voluntarily transmits (browser geolocation permission) or enters manually (neighbourhood, city); it is never activated without an explicit action by the user and is never required to use the rest of the service.
cguPage.s16Body2: A provider remains free to choose the level of precision of the position displayed publicly on their listing (neighbourhood or precise position) and may delete the position saved on their account at any time, whether client or provider, as described in the Privacy Policy.
cguPage.s17Body1: WorkTogo provides an automated conversational assistant, designed to answer questions about how the platform works and direct users to genuinely registered providers. It is an artificial intelligence tool, which does not replace human support, accessible at any time.
cguPage.s17Body2: The assistant's recommendations rely exclusively on real platform data (profiles actually registered); they in no way constitute a contractual commitment by WorkTogo nor a guarantee of the recommended provider's availability, competence or rate, which remain governed by articles 4 and following of these ToS.
cguPage.s17Body3: In the event the assistant is unavailable, the user retains full access to standard search and messaging.
cguPage.s18Body1: WorkTogo may amend these ToS to reflect developments in the service or regulations. Users are informed of any substantial change; continued use of the service after the changes take effect constitutes acceptance.
cguPage.s19Body1: These ToS are governed by Togolese law. In the event of a dispute, the parties will endeavour to find an amicable solution before any legal action; failing that, the competent Togolese courts shall have sole jurisdiction.
